# googleads_shared_criterion (Resource)

A keyword inside a `googleads_shared_set` of type NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS. The Ads API has no update operation for shared criteria — every field is immutable, so any change forces resource replacement. v1 covers keyword criteria only; placements/brands/etc. land in a future PR.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_shared_criterion" "free" {
  customer_id   = "1234567890"
  shared_set_id = googleads_shared_set.brand_negatives.id
  keyword_text  = "free"
  match_type    = "BROAD"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `keyword_text` (String) Keyword text. Immutable.
- `match_type` (String) EXACT, PHRASE, or BROAD. Immutable.
- `shared_set_id` (String) Parent shared set resource name. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/sharedCriteria/{shared_set_id}~{criterion_id}).
